premises.text: Brands need a new production process bridging controlled studio video and explosive UGC
premises.evidence_span: What we want to do is bring these 2 worlds together. We want to create an entirely new process for production

premises.text: Clients mobilize their own communities as filmers for high-impact video at scale
premises.evidence_span: enabling companies to produce high-impact video at scale by engaging their own communities of fans, customers, and employees to become the filmers

premises.text: Platform tools let clients run projects with filming instructions for invited community members
premises.evidence_span: they set up a project, they set a project ID, and then they loaded filming instruction that they wanted their community to capture. They then invited a select number of people to join the project

premises.text: App terms let clients reuse uploaded community video online or in broadcast
premises.evidence_span: Because of the terms and conditions in the app, all the video that's uploaded can then be used by the BBC, whether it's online or even in the broadcast shows

premises.text: Automatic tagging/analysis plus multiple edit routes turn community uploads into finished video
premises.evidence_span: automatically tagged, analyzed, and processed on upload as well. Then there's 3 ways to edit either we have our online edit tools

premises.text: ML content search (sentiment, object recognition, transcription) unlocks reuse of the library
premises.evidence_span: content search tools so you can now search sentiment analysis object recognition and transcription

premises.text: Business model is subscription studios rather than pay-as-you-go
premises.evidence_span: initially we started off as a pay as you go but now we're fully into a subscription model

domains.name: Briefing, rights, processing, and search tools

value.text: Scale authentic community-produced video for brands and broadcasters
value.evidence_span: changing the way that our clients are thinking about how they might produce their next video

secondary_value.text: Real employee/community content that connects with audiences
secondary_value.evidence_span: best performing video online, because it's real and it connects

causal_links.evidence_span: building the tools to enable our clients to engage and create with their own communities
